study: Stage C meteorological uncertainty around accepted Stage B dynamic models

validation.criteria_status: Declared before inspecting generated validation results. Exploratory adequacy screens, not physical calibration or extreme-risk certification.

scenarios.population: Ordinary September six-day weather windows conditioned on the target calendar, without storm, flood or successful-simulation selection
scenarios.cold_rule: Do not simulate any window containing T_air <= 0 C. Retain and count excluded windows. No temperature clipping.

hydrology.controls: Existing frozen Stage B prescribed gate schedules
hydrology.boundary_policy: Keep Q_ext, h_d, h_g and B from accepted Stage B configuration
hydrology.initial_policy: Match shared states by name and retain accepted wetland-specific initial water. No hydrologic spin-up.

summary.benefit_tolerance_basis: Existing Stage B peak-grid screen 0.001 m, conservatively above the saved deterministic 60-to-30 s changes. Check against Stage C representative refinement; unresolved or larger error prevents millimetre-effect claims.
